info.title: Hourora time zone API
info.description: The same engine that runs Hourora, as plain JSON: the time anywhere, conversions that know about daylight saving, every IANA zone and its clock changes. No key, no sign-up. IANA tzdata 2026f. 120 requests per minute per client.

get.description: The current time in a time zone or city: local time, UTC offset, abbreviation, daylight saving and the next clock change. Without parameters: UTC.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. Europe/London. Aliases such as Asia/Calcutta are accepted and answered with the current name.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City slug instead of tz, e.g. london (find slugs with /cities).

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: A wall-clock time in one zone shown in another. Reports when the time falls in a daylight-saving gap (it does not exist) or overlap (it happens twice).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Zone (or city slug) the time is read in.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Zone (or city slug) to show it in.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Wall-clock time in the from zone, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm (seconds optional, no offset), 1970–2060. Default: now.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: Every IANA time zone with its current UTC offset, abbreviation, daylight-saving state, countries and main city.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166 country code, e.g. GB, to keep only that country.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: One IANA zone: its aliases, countries and cities, its offset now, the next clock change and every change in a given year.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: IANA zone name; keep the slash or encode it as %2F.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Year whose clock changes to list, 1970–2060. Default: this year.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: Cities whose name matches, best matches and largest cities first, each with its country, coordinates and time zone.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a city name, accents optional (at most 80 characters).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166 country code, e.g. GB, to keep only that country.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: One city by its slug, with its time zone's offset now and the next clock change.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: The nearest listed city to a latitude and longitude, and its time zone. An approximation: zone borders are not modelled.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

get.description: Which IANA time zone database release the answers come from, and when Hourora last updated its data.

400.description: A parameter is missing or not in the expected form.

404.description: No such time zone, city, country or endpoint.

429.description: Too many requests from your client; wait for the seconds in Retry-After.

abbreviation.description: tzdata abbreviation when it has a letter one (CEST, IST, PDT), else null

localBefore.description: Wall clock at the change, old offset

localAfter.description: Wall clock at the change, new offset
